name: Dreamsand
description: A fine, iridescent sand that shifts between soft pastel colors when disturbed. When inhaled or sprinkled over a willing creature, it induces a deep sleep filled with vivid dreams within minutes. A creature that sleeps under the effects of dreamsand for at least 4 hours gains the benefits of a full rest and recovers 1 additional resolve upon waking. Commonly traded among fey creatures and used by healers to calm agitated patients or treat those suffering from insomnia.
